underlying_sources: Cheng et al. (Figshare, 3064 T1-CE MRI slices from 233 patients)
dataset_audit.patient_level_leakage_risk: HIGH (Dataset lacks patient IDs; slices likely cross-contaminate splits)
dataset_audit.external_validation: NONE (Evaluated solely on in-distribution test split)

missed_as_healthy_notumor.hazard_description: Patient with active infiltrative glioma is informed no lesion is detected. Leads to delayed oncological intervention, tumor progression, and compromised survival.

confused_with_meningioma.hazard_description: Glioma misidentified as extra-axial meningioma. While lesion detection succeeds, surgical margin planning, biopsy strategy, and urgency differ fundamentally.

confused_with_pituitary.hazard_description: Anatomical discrepancy: intra-axial glioma misattributed to sellar/pituitary region.

safety_recommendations: Implement high-sensitivity screening threshold for the Glioma class.
Do not discharge patients based solely on automated 'No Tumor' output.
Integrate multi-modal MRI sequences (T2-FLAIR) to detect hyperintense peritumoral edema.
Mandate secondary radiologist review on all scans with Glioma probability > 0.15.
